legalName.title: Legal name / 法定姓名
legalName.description: Enter your legal name in Chinese, English, or both. / 可填写中文、英文或同时填写。

contactEmail.title: Contact email / 联系邮箱
contactEmail.description: Used only for agreement and rights-chain administration. / 仅用于协议与权利链管理。

legalCapacity.title: I have legal capacity to accept this agreement. / 我具备接受本协议的法律行为能力。
legalCapacity.description: Do not sign if a guardian process is required and has not been approved. / 如需监护人程序且项目尚未批准，请勿签署。

rightsAuthority.title: I own or control the necessary rights and have obtained any required employer or organization approval. / 我拥有或控制必要权利，并已取得雇主或组织要求的批准。
rightsAuthority.description: Contact the project before signing if an organization owns the Contribution. / 如果贡献归组织所有，请先联系项目。

privacyNotice.title: I have read the CLA privacy notice. / 我已阅读 CLA 隐私说明。
privacyNotice.description: The notice explains the signing data and retention workflow. / 该说明解释签署数据和保留流程。

internationalTransfer.title: I consent to the processing and international transfer of signing data as described in the CLA privacy notice. / 我同意按照 CLA 隐私说明处理并向境外服务商传输签署数据。
internationalTransfer.description: The designated signing service may process signing data outside mainland China. / 指定签署服务可能在中国大陆境外处理签署数据。
